issues.description: Constructor parameter mismatch for Animal subclasses: the template's commented example in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java instantiates Seal, Pig, and Goat with two String arguments (e.g., new Seal("Clarabelle", "marine")), while the problem statement UML and the reference solution define Animal and its subclasses with a single-argument constructor that accepts only the name (e.g., public Animal(String name) and usage new Seal("Clarabelle")). This inconsistency can confuse students about the required constructor signatures and will cause compilation errors if they uncomment the template examples but implement constructors as specified in the UML/solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the artifacts consistent. Recommended: update the template src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java commented instantiations to call the single-argument constructors (e.g., new Seal("Clarabelle"), new Pig("Doodle"), new Goat("Buttinsky")). Alternatively, if a second attribute was intended, update the problem statement UML and the solution/template classes (Animal and all subclasses) to include and initialize that additional attribute and change constructors and example calls accordingly so all artifacts share the same constructor signature.
